There is absolutely nothing wrong with just being normal! Navigating a new high school is tough enough without feeling like you have to force yourself into a specific box or label just to find a place to sit at lunch. It is completely understandable that an intense clique culture feels overwhelming and restrictive. 

Starting "The Normal Ones" sounds like a fantastic and refreshing idea. Chances are, there are plenty of other students at your school who feel exactly the same way you do—caught in the middle and just wanting to hang out without a strict group identity. Staying true to yourself is the best way to attract genuine friends who appreciate you for who you are, rather than what clique you belong to. Keep embracing your own path; you might just create the most welcoming group in the whole school.
